title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
source: FLAC > DDi Codec (Dolby B) > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: A beautifully polished remaster that delivers crystal‑clear sound; reviewers hail it as a gem.
ai_review.review: The single five‑star review praises the recording’s meticulous cutting and polishing, indicating an excellent soundboard source that has been expertly remastered. No specific musical moments are mentioned, but the overall tone suggests the performance is held in high regard alongside the superb audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one enthusiastic review (5 stars) focuses on recording excellence; with no detail on performance, rating reflects strong technical praise but limited data on show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered with careful cutting and polishing; clear, balanced mix praised as a GD gem.
